selected_evidence.requirement: Discover why a naive GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT edit would be silently overridden
selected_evidence.summary: Found cloud-image grub drop-in overrides GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT; first attempt via that variable did not appear in grub.cfg

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently add audit=1 to kernel boot parameters
selected_evidence.summary: Set GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="audit=1" (unaffected by the cloud-image override) and regenerated grub.cfg; audit=1 confirmed present in the normal, recovery, and submenu boot entries

selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline and boot identity before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-reboot boot_id (e8afb731-420c-4162-a989-583aca271335) and pre-reboot /proc/cmdline lacking audit=1
Backgrounded sudo reboot; exec stream closed as the node went down, confirming the command was issued and the restart proceeded

selected_evidence.requirement: Node becomes reachable again and boot identity changed
selected_evidence.summary: Polled through connection timeouts/resets until exec succeeded; new boot_id 9c08d859-3312-4cfb-8f43-857853968ee6 differs from the pre-reboot value, proving an actual reboot occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Kernel actually booted with audit=1 across the reboot (the core task outcome)
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot /proc/cmdline contains audit=1 and dmesg shows 'audit: enabled (after initialization)' with audit_enabled=1, res=1

selected_evidence.requirement: Setting remains configured for future reboots and system is healthy post-restart
selected_evidence.summary: /etc/default/grub still shows GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="audit=1" post-reboot and systemctl is-system-running reports 'running'
